title: Server Commands
content:
/lostfound - Get back your own stuff lost to lava, fire, the void or a despawn in the last 7 days
/trash - Throw items away. /trash undo works for 5 minutes
/mark - Choose if things you craft say "Crafted by" with your name
/ask - Ask the Guide anything about the server

Buttons below run the command. Lines with <words> in them need typing in chat instead.
